name: cooktech-mixer-ability-2-pays-its-printed-cost
notes: CookTech Mixer, ability 2: the printed activation cost (REST, Banish/Sacrifice CARDNAME, (N), extra costs) used to be unpaid, so the ability ran for free and repeatedly. Activated here in a generic environment (Guo Jia level-3 champion with the card's class, allies, Powercell, graveyard and memory cards, a Bow, six hand cards of reserve fuel); the assertions pin the cost that is now paid. Costs live in GAFieldAbilityCostTable() (Custom/GameLogic.php).

rulesClauses: Printed activation cost of CookTech Mixer ability 2

engineBug.summary: CookTech Mixer ability 2 never paid its printed activation cost (it ran free and could be repeated).
